(☉ㅅ☉U)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 19 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mega Slow''' was a large and tough [[Enemies|enemy]] which only appeared on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. While it had slightly slow speed, it had very high health for its debut. This makes it a very dangerous threat. Additionally, it has 15% defense, reducing the effectiveness of some towers. It also has [[Stun Immunity]], which makes the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] only slow it down and makes it immune to knockback. The '''Mega Slow''' can be spawned by the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] and [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]], in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode only. The [[Mystery Boss]] can also spawn the '''Mega Slow''' upon its death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current (Version 1 & 3) |The first and current '''Mega Slow''' is a large enemy. It is slightly smaller than the [[Giant Boss]]. It has a reflective green skin color and is faceless. It has tumors on its left arm and head. Its torso, sleeves and legs are granite black. It also has a metal armband on its right arm and has hooks growing on both of its shoulders. It also has a small black axe stabbed into its back. It walks slightly hunchbacked and has a twisted left leg. |Version 2 |The second '''Mega Slow''' was similar to its current version except it had only one hook on its shoulder. }} ==Strategy== *Because of the '''Mega Slow's''' early appearance and the increased prices of towers and upgrades in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, it may be the downfall of most players if they are unprepared for it. **For this reason, [[Farm]]s are heavily recommended so that you will be able to afford more expensive upgrades sooner. ***Depending on the length of the map, most players can continue farming until the '''Mega Slow''' reaches the main defense, assuming it is set up in the back. **Additionally, if multiple [[Lead Boss]]es were spawned from [[Mystery|Mysteries]] on previous waves, the '''Mega Slow's''' debut can easily lead to a defeat on a shorter map. ***If you are playing on a map with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier, [[Lead Boss]]es will be less of a problem on their own, as [[Mystery|Mysteries]] are replaced by [[Breaker2]]s. *High DPS towers, such as a couple Level 2 [[Golden Minigunner]]s, [[Accelerator]]s or [[Turret]]s, are highly recommended against the '''Mega Slow'''. **If you are using [[Turret]] to take down the '''Mega Slow''', extra towers may be required depending on the map as it has less DPS than [[Accelerator]]. **The [[Engineer]] is not recommended because it has slow DPS at low levels. *Level 3 [[Golden Scout]] and Level 2 [[Golden Soldier]] spam are effective against the '''Mega Slow''' if there are enough of them, although towers with lead detection, such as the [[Golden Pyromancer]] or [[Mortar]], will also be needed to deal with the [[Lead Boss]]es that spawn before the '''Mega Slow'''. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]]s and [[Humvee 3]]s can be effective against this enemy, as they deal full collision damage to defense enemies. Once the '''Mega Slow''' begins to spawn in hordes, however, their effectiveness is reduced. *A Level 4 [[Golden Scout]] can easily take down the '''Mega Slow''' for a relatively cheap price. *You can use slowing towers, such as the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Sledger]] to slow this enemy down. **As the '''Mega Slow''' has the [[Stun Immunity]], stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] will only slow it down instead of completely stopping it. Additionally, it prevents it from being knocked back. **Freezing towers and the [[Warden]] can only slow it down for a shorter period of time compared to an average-sized enemy, due to its large size. **The [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]], [[Cryomancer]] and [[Frost Blaster]] can also remove the '''Mega Slow's''' defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage. ***This can stack, so the [[Freezer]]/[[Frost Blaster]]/[[Cryomancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can together remove up to 53% of its defense. ***The [[Pyromancer]] can also remove 50% of '''Mega Slow's''' defense, allowing your towers to deal even more damage. ***Poison defense dropping towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]] can also drop 50% of its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} MegaSlowBugged.png|Second version (8 May 2021 – 23 March 2022) MegaSlow.png|First & Current version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021, 23 March 2022 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMegaSlow.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMegaSlow.png|'''Mega Slow''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The appearance of the '''Mega Slow''' is similar to the old design of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Boss4|Boss4]] from ''Tower Battles''. *Weirdly, the health of the '''Mega Slow''' was increased in [[MEGA Servers]], despite it not being able to spawn in a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]] without admin commands. *When the '''Mega Slow''' was frozen by the [[Sledger]] prior to the 23rd of March 2022, it had a chance to create a huge wall of ice. **This was due to one of its hooks being able to fall off of itself and fall far below the map, and the ice would attempt to encompass the hook. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' -
